Car Magnet

Turn your vehicle into a mobile billboard. No paint, no permanence, no problem.

These custom car magnets are the easiest way to promote your business, support your favorite team or add a little personality to your ride.

Made from durable, weather-resistant magnetic material, they stick securely to any metal surface and peel off cleanly whenever you're ready for a change. They are built to last, reusable and extremely versatile.

Turn a vehicle into a mobile billboard — no paint, no permanence. These custom car magnets are made from durable, weather-resistant magnetic material that sticks securely to any metal surface and peels off cleanly when it's time for a change. Businesses, sports teams, and campaigns order these to advertise on company or personal vehicles.

Common Use Cases

  • Business advertising on company or employee vehicles
  • Sports team and organization support magnets
  • Local campaign and event promotion on personal vehicles
  • Temporary vehicle branding that can be swapped between events

Frequently Asked Questions

What sizes are available for car magnets?

Five sizes, from 18 x 12 up to a large 72 x 24 magnet. Pick your size in the configurator above.

Will the magnet damage my vehicle's paint?

The magnetic material is designed to stick securely without paint damage and peel off cleanly. As with any magnet, we recommend removing it periodically to clean underneath.

Can Cornerstone design my car magnet artwork?

Yes, design services are available as an add-on per side during checkout.

What's the minimum order?

2 magnets, with quantity breaks at 4, 10, 20, and 50.
